selection_rule: failures, timely64, timely96, sum_of_separate_p95; baseline wins ties
quality_scope: 10 frozen examples; compare entity types/counts/offsets at threshold .35, not exact floating scores
limitations: Mock provider, not loaded external GLM/ChatGPT or production user state
Whitespace generator units are not external LLM tokens
Single screening waves select candidates; repeated confirmations determine the comparison
CPU peaks are interval averages and memory sums are not perfectly simultaneous
Waiting outside Analyzer is not a direct internal HTTP-pool timer
Model-quality probes are bounded, not a fresh full quality benchmark
No sustained load, mixed histories, large files, cancellation/fault or two-node acceptance
